display.use: Expressive Vietnamese hooks and the dominant phrase on evidence cards. The bundled Barlow Condensed font includes Vietnamese glyphs; use short phrases and strong scale contrast.

latin_auxiliary.use: Oversized chapter numbers, stat values, English tags, and compact score numerals.

body.use: Vietnamese narration captions, evidence labels and source credit.

rules: Set hooks in short Vietnamese phrases; emphasize one meaningful word with a contrasting color or paper strip.
Use Barlow Condensed Bold for short Vietnamese hooks, big numbers, and compact English tags; use Be Vietnam Pro for body copy and dense evidence labels.
Create a three-step hierarchy: hook, key evidence, quiet attribution. Avoid report-like piles of small labels.
Use hand-drawn strokes, slanted tabs, and registration marks sparingly, each tied to a story point.
Keep Vietnamese diacritics intact; never synthesize bold for body copy.
On-screen copy is sparse and explanatory; do not transcribe the narration.

layout.host_share: Narrative is carried by voice. Visual evidence owns the frame when it clarifies the point.
layout.caption_anchor: No persistent subtitles; use the frame for authored diagrams or approved media.
layout.evidence_card: One sourced claim when needed; match diagrams and media remain the visual focus.
layout.visual_signature: Touchline editorial: stable ink-and-chalk identity, oversized Vietnamese hooks, condensed statistic numerals, context-aware team color, tactile pitch marks, and evidence-specific graphic plates.

motion.default_easing: Smooth ease-in-out with a decisive stop.
motion.micro_motion: Use one eased ball movement per authored pass; stop at the receiver. Let a headline reveal by short line wipe, a stat value snap in once, and hand-mark vectors draw once. Switch layout with the story; no looping decoration.

audio.narration: Primary and intelligible; music and effects duck under speech.
audio.signature_cue: Original two-note, dry percussive/electronic mark; no stock broadcast whistle or copied club anthem.
audio.music: Optional low-energy bed; never required and never louder than speech.

research_basis.Tifo_Football: Use illustration and animation to make one complex idea legible; do not copy its hand-drawn character style.
research_basis.Independent_ACFC: Pair a clear analysis claim with a match or player focal point and tactical context.
research_basis.Premier_League_Breakdown: Color-code the subject, movement path, and target zone so overlays explain the evidence.
research_basis.adaptation: An original Vietnamese-first editorial dossier: warm restrained accents, chapter numbering, asymmetrical evidence layout, real approved media slots, and simple authored tactical plates. Player markers use numbered kit tokens, team color and a distinct focus highlight following common tactical-board conventions. Evidence graphics now use deliberately distinct visual grammars: split head-to-head scoreboard for statlines, a light labeled plot with zero baseline for comparison charts, and an archival paper pull-quote for source provenance. Version 0.8 adds an editorial plotting-sheet finish with clear chart-specific grammar: ranked bars, compact columns, chronological line plots, and restrained part-to-whole pie/donut marks; no chart is selected without matching data semantics.
